-- GA-9: Add D candidate C. Gegen (won D primary 60%)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate2_name = 'Andrew Clyde',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  candidate1_name = 'C. Gegen',
  candidate1_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district = '9';

-- GA-10: Add D candidate P. Delancy (won D primary 54.4%)
UPDATE house_races SET 
  candidate2_name = 'Houston Gaines',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  candidate1_name = 'P. Delancy',
  candidate1_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district = '10';

SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM house_races WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district IN ('9','10','11','12');
